title: Episodic Mirror adapter to semantic consolidation

protocol_amendment.timing: before corrected development rerun; no fresh/audit data accessed
protocol_amendment.reason: The initial serialization used longer NPZ field names for native PCA than Mirror, creating a small metadata-only byte difference for identical arrays.
protocol_amendment.change: Equivalent Mirror and native PCA arrays use identical field names, array order and serializer so exact aliases have equal serialized bytes.

hypothesis: For aligned episode-conditioned linear functions, transferring a compact shared-basis episode code bank into a persistent consolidated base and deleting the episode store preserves episode recall at lower complete serialized bytes and bounded lookup compute than independent full episode adapters.

task.recall_metric: NRMSE of recovered episode output vector on all 24 basis-fit episodes; held-out episodes are reported separately and are never used to fit the basis

development.selection_metric: post-deletion training-episode recall NRMSE, total serialized bytes, lookup MAC proxy, and exact serialized replay

fresh.open_only_if: development meets quality/storage/compute gates and no exact function+compute alias to native PCA consolidation

controls: Independent full episode-vector bank (exact retrieval upper control)
Shared rank-4 episode code bank using SVD-fitted basis
Consolidated dense base containing reconstructed episode vectors
Native PCA basis plus ordinary episode coefficients, transferred and retired identically

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes measured from deterministic compressed NPZ files
storage.snapshots: measure base plus episode store before transfer, during duplicate transfer, and base only after deletion; report the duplicate transient peak separately

compute.lookup_mac_proxy: dense lookup counts zero multiply-accumulates; rank-r basis decode counts r*32 MACs per episode lookup
compute.transfer_mac_proxy: count basis decode for every transferred episode; report one-time consolidation separately
compute.wall_clock: measure encode, transfer, serialization and batch lookup on CPU; timing is descriptive at this small scale

success_gate: After episode-store deletion, training recall NRMSE <=0.02, full serialized bytes <=75% of independent bank, lookup MAC <=256 per vector retrieval, and a strict Pareto gain over the native PCA consolidation control.
failure_gate: Recall loss after deletion, failure of quality/bytes/compute thresholds, or exact native PCA function/compute alias without strict Pareto gain. If exact alias is observed, fresh remains sealed.
boundaries: Synthetic vector-valued linear memory only; no language-model, semantic recall, continual-learning or learned-editor claim.
The 8 held-out episodes are excluded from basis fitting and are reported as generalization diagnostics, not included in the retention gate.
Consolidation is an explicit deterministic state transfer; no extra task information is supplied after episode-store deletion.
Both Mirror codes and native PCA coefficients are fully charged; metadata and episode IDs are included.
No fresh/audit results may tune rank, gates or implementation.
